outbox.atomicity_requirement: The state change and its outbox record share a single committed governance transaction; an event is never durably recorded without its committed state change.
outbox.publication_eligibility: An outbox record becomes eligible for publication only after its governing transaction commits and its publication preconditions are satisfied.

outbox.atomicity_requirement: The pending outbox record remains the durable record that a governed event is owed until it is published or governed to a terminal disposition.

semantics.exactly_once_business_invariant: Exactly-once business effect, such as activating an affiliation once, is a business invariant enforced by governed state and consumer idempotency, never presumed from transport.
The one-time business effect is enforced by governed state and idempotent consumers; the transport provides at-least-once delivery only.
